# Current official account features and lending FAQ fixtures

Nine immutable current official HTML captures, collected on 2026-10-14 UTC
(2026-10-13 America/Vancouver). `sources.json` records exact URL, capture time,
filename and SHA-256 of the original decompressed bytes. Gzip has deterministic
mtime0; it does not edit the source. Do not replace captures to satisfy a test.

LANDBANK: three positive savings details plus PISO's insufficient monthly-cost
proof. Chinabank: HomePlus detail, FAQ index and named application FAQ. Security
Bank: Easy Savings detail and its literal linked fees/charges page. These are
public official captures; private operational mappings and evidence stay in ignored
temporary storage. Original quotations and currencies remain in their language.

Tests use the real parser and 900-character/120-overlap chunk builder, shared
extraction, normalization and final automatic gates. Success and issuer mutations
must preserve full annual/fee/earning-balance/fixing/repayment conditions. Wrong
country/sibling/return links, missing annual basis/repricing/cadence/threshold,
unproved responsive aliases, shortened conditions and guessed scalars/zeros fail
closed. The actual FAQ index traversal uses the existing two-wave/two-URL cap.

See the collection report (`e391c209d398:docs/00-governance/ph-additional-collection-publication-2026-10-13.md` in Git history).
